# Command-line reference

**Audience:** operators and integrators. Every command and option of the
`ferrobridge` binary, as `ferrobridge <command> --help` prints it.
[Configuring the server](../operate/configuration.md) describes the
configuration every command reads.

<!-- toc -->

## `ferrobridge`

```text
The FerroBRIDGE bridge between openEHR, HL7 FHIR and the OMOP CDM

Usage: ferrobridge [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  serve        Serves until the process is asked to stop
  config       Works on the configuration
  healthcheck  Asks the server running beside this process whether it is ready, and exits 0 only when it is
  etl          Runs an OMOP extract, transform and load job
  cdm          Works on the OMOP CDM database
  vocab        Works on the OHDSI vocabulary
  dq           Checks the quality of the CDM database
  mapping      Works on the mapping files
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          One configuration key set over the file and the environment, as `key=value`; repeatable

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## `ferrobridge etl`

```text
Runs an OMOP extract, transform and load job

Usage: ferrobridge etl [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  run   Loads compositions from the CDR into the CDM database
  fhir  Loads FHIR R4 resources, a Bundle or an NDJSON file, into the CDM database through FHIRconnect and OMOCL, with no CDR
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          One configuration key set over the file and the environment, as `key=value`; repeatable

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `ferrobridge etl run`

```text
Loads compositions from the CDR into the CDM database

Usage: ferrobridge etl run [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it

      --resume
          Skips every composition whose watermark names the version the query answers

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          One configuration key set over the file and the environment, as `key=value`; repeatable

      --since <TIME>
          Binds the value to the composition query's `$since` parameter

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

```text
Runs the ported Data Quality Dashboard checks against the configured database and exits non-zero when a check fails or cannot be evaluated

Options:

  -h, --help
```
